title: Clarkdale Cement Plant as egress to secret facility
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Clarkdale Cement Plant as egress to secret facility, about recent at Clarkdale, Arizona, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's an egress point into this whole secret facility called the Clarkdale Cement Plant.

plain: An Australian journalist named Ross Coulthart, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on what someone told him about a hidden facility in Arizona that he links to UFOs. According to Coulthart, one way in and out of this secret site is through the Clarkdale Cement Plant, a cement works in the small town of Clarkdale, Arizona. If true, it would mean an ordinary industrial building is hiding the door to a secret base.
